<function name="OnRowRightClick" parent="DListView" type="panelhook">
	<description>Called when a row is right-clicked</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="lineID" type="number">The line ID of the right clicked line</arg>
		<arg name="line" type="Panel">The line panel itself, a <page>DListView_Line</page>.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
